title_zh: 根据失败原型的测试记录决定先查传感器

scenario.label_zh: 根据失败原型的测试记录决定先查传感器
scenario.goal_zh: 区分已测试项目和未测试条件，约定单独检查传感器后再改动原型

context_zh: 两名产品开发同事复盘未能完成演示的原型。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Niko
sentences.text: Are we keeping the failed prototype, or should I clear the bench?

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: Keep it. We need to understand the failure before we change anything.

sentences.speaker: Niko
sentences.text: I tested the motor extensively, so I assumed the whole system would work.

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: But the log shows the sensor stopped sending data when the room got dark. Did we test that condition?

sentences.speaker: Niko
sentences.text: No. All my tests were under the work lamp.

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: Then we can still gain something useful from this. Let us test the sensor separately in different light levels.

sentences.speaker: Niko
sentences.text: I will set that up and keep the original wiring unchanged.

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: Good. We can decide what to change after we have those results.
